intro: All ten templates that failed in v0.9 passed the seventh screen with full marks, each in at least three pictures: the redesigned empty cone, told apart from a full one in none of the v0.9 pictures, read in all five v0.10 pictures (the child crying and holding an empty cone "because her pink ice cream has fallen"). The set scored the best or equal best of the seven screens on every row of the headline: 0.98 over all items, inferences 0.92, contradictions 1.00, and no item misread. 59 of 64 templates pass the gate, up from 54; the five that now fail all passed in v0.9 and its retest, two on a single misread in a probe and three on half points, each with a cause visible in the picture (`vision/flaws_v010.md`).
screen: Across all 57 pictures only 12 of 683 scored items fell short of full marks, and the two misreads were both in probes. In the set the inference points lost were all half points: two kites "flying there or caught", two storm pictures in which nobody said it was about to rain, and the blocked hose in the busiest garden. Unintended oddities fell from 2.3 to 1.5 per picture, the same as the retest of the v0.9 pictures; the most frequent, in three probes, was an ordinary seesaw with the bigger child up.
redrawn: Every one of the ten reads with full marks. The ice cream redesign carried its inference in every picture; the giant fork on the paving, with the dustpan beyond the heap, read as sweeping in all three ("sweeping with a giant silver dinner fork ... instead of a broom or rake"); the upward stream was "physically impossible for a watering can"; the child on the slide was "sliding down it with both arms raised".
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (54 in three, 10 in four to six), so the verdicts rest on 388 scored items instead of 302. The five failures each have a cause visible in the picture: a waving man against the house corner ("peeking out or watching"), a reach for the ball in the tree beside a hat blowing away, a kite drawn whole in front of the canopy, a child pointing at the storm from under a tree with a fish in it, a play-bowing dog facing a wheelbarrow. The retest put reader variance at about five templates, so the count of 59 matches the retest of the v0.9 pictures; what changed is which templates fail and why.
